description: This Java class models a thread pool configuration, parsing XML attributes to initialize thread pool parameters such as min/max threads, polling interval, and retry settings.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: A thread-safe class that models the <thread-pool> XML element, encapsulating thread pool configuration parameters.

methods.name: getFailedRetryMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum retry delay in seconds for failed tasks.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Returns the queue size for jobs.

methods.name: getMaxThreads
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of threads allowed in the pool.

methods.name: getMinThreads
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of threads in the pool.

methods.name: getPollDbMillis
methods.description: Returns the polling interval in milliseconds for database polling.

methods.name: getPurgeJobDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days to purge completed jobs.

methods.name: getRunFromPools
methods.description: Returns the list of run-from-pool configurations.

methods.name: getSendToPool
methods.description: Returns the name of the pool to send tasks to.

methods.name: getTtl
methods.description: Returns the thread idle time-to-live in milliseconds.
